budget_title: Noise budget at the input, on the chip
budget: AFE: every device and resistor of the chip at the operating point its wiring gives the AFE (pad cells, straps, the bias ground offset; afe_chip_noise.py, AFE_IBIAS 3, Monte Carlo 30: 5.34 ± 0.07 nV rms, worst die 5.50 nV rms, 16.41 bit). ADC and blanking as budgeted on 10/26. Until 9 Nov the total also had a pads-and-straps line (1.5 nV rms) that the AFE line already holds (16.40 bit with it).
afe_noise: Harmonic-sum gain 287.3 V/V in the schematic, 284.8 V/V extracted, 283.2 V/V on the chip. The rise comes from the larger input-node capacitance, the input-path wiring, and on the chip the AFE's operating point there (bias ground offset, pad cells), typical, AFE_IBIAS 3.
checks_sub: DRC, LVS with two tools, pad-ring and supply checks, wafer.space precheck, Magic and digital verification · 24 Oct – 9 Nov 2026
checks: Precheck pre_20261109_r10: --slot 1x0p5 --cob as the shuttle specifies, latest image (20 Oct, PDK 792ef670; still the latest on 9 Nov). The pad-ring checks and the whole-chip LVS came in on 29 Oct, after the core's DVDD was found cut from its pads in r0–r7; the tap check on 9 Nov, after the quantizer's latch ground was found open in r0–r9 (the LVS ties DVSS into AVSS, so it could not see it). r9 fails the tap check there, r10 passes.
rwire: Final layout: measured on the r9 chip (pex_rin.py), the same as r6 to the milliohm. T was set by the auto-routed gate wiring of the input pair before the D6 fixes. The per-side target for 16.50 bit (0.35 Ω) is for this chip wiring; the pad cells' own Metal2 (asig_5p0, two in parallel per electrode, 0.636 Ω per side, found on 27 Oct) comes on top: 1.27 / 1.33 Ω per side.
metrics: AFE: afe_top's extraction (unchanged since r6); gain from the ±0.5 mV chopped transient (200 µs). ADC: the schematic and the final column with C1 and C2 x1.25 (the r10 extraction of adc_top; its loop run matches the r7 extraction's: same DAC1 sequence, O2 within 21 µV); loop at 20 kHz, 0.3 V pk, 100 µs, evaluated over 20–100 µs (80 frames); DAC1's even-order error from its own block's extraction (unchanged since r6). Behavioural SNDR: ELD 0.22 of a clock (reproduces the transistor loop), typical. The 10/23 column is that day's extraction and model (ELD 3/32).
